name: Healthy Life Agritec Ltd.
summary: Healthy Life Agritec Ltd. specializes in agricultural products. The company's primary business involves the trading of raw milk within Maharashtra, and live poultry along with various agricultural commodities across both Maharashtra and Karnataka. Additionally, it actively sources live birds directly from poultry farmers located in these two Indian states. Healthy Life Agritec was established in November 2019 and is headquartered in Thane, India.
